servers.name: mcp-remotetouch

servers.description: Enables Model Context Protocol tools for automating web browsers and Electron desktop applications using Playwright's accessibility tree snapshots. It supports window management and JavaScript execution in the main process, providing deterministic automation through structured data.

cwd.description: Path to your Electron application's working directory.

caps.description: Comma-separated list of capabilities to enable, possible values: tabs, pdf, history, wait, files, install. Default is all.

host.description: Host to bind server to. Default is localhost. Use 0.0.0.0 to bind to all interfaces.

port.description: Port to listen on for SSE transport.

vision.description: Run server that uses screenshots (Aria snapshots are used by default).

browser.description: Browser or chrome channel to use, possible values: chrome, firefox, webkit, msedge, electron.

headless.description: Run browser in headless mode, headed by default.

isolated.description: Keep the browser profile in memory, do not save it to disk.

no-sandbox.description: Disable the sandbox for all process types that are normally sandboxed.

output-dir.description: Path to the directory for output files.

save-trace.description: Whether to save the Playwright Trace of the session into the output directory.

proxy-bypass.description: Comma-separated domains to bypass proxy, for example ".com,chromium.org,.domain.com"

proxy-server.description: Specify proxy server, for example "http://myproxy:3128" or "socks5://myproxy:8080"

storage-state.description: Path to the storage state file for isolated sessions.

user-data-dir.description: Path to the user data directory. If not specified, a temporary directory will be created.

viewport-size.description: Specify browser viewport size in pixels, for example "1280, 720"

allowed-origins.description: Semicolon-separated list of origins to allow the browser to request. Default is to allow all.

blocked-origins.description: Semicolon-separated list of origins to block the browser from requesting. Blocklist is evaluated before allowlist. If used without the allowlist, requests not matching the blocklist are still allowed.

image-responses.description: Whether to send image responses to the client. Can be "allow", "omit", or "auto". Defaults to "auto", which sends images if the client can display them.

servers.name: Playwright MCP with Electron Support
